program.blurb: Fast, powerful hips for pounding her: AMRAPs of bridge pulses and frog pumps, swings, thrusters and core.
program.about: Speed and power from the hips, so you can pound her pussy and not slow down. One day is an AMRAP of bridge pulses, frog pumps and squats, as many rounds as you can; the other is kettlebell swings and thrusters in straight sets, with core after. Fast hip extension, repeated without slowing down, is the whole point. Level II adds reps and Level III asks for heavier weights.
